statement: For D(x)=(2d)^(-1)1_{||x||_1=1} on Z^d and Dhat(k)=d^(-1) sum_j cos(k_j), the integral over [-pi,pi]^d of (1-Dhat(k))^(-3) is finite if and only if d>6.
assumptions: Lebesgue measure on the Fourier torus
source: Elementary derivation recorded in ATTEMPT.md; no novelty asserted.
proof: For |t|<=pi, 2t^2/pi^2 <= 1-cos(t) <= t^2/2. Thus 2|k|^2/(d*pi^2) <= 1-Dhat(k) <= |k|^2/(2d). Near zero the integral has the same convergence as integral_0^epsilon r^(d-7) dr; away from zero the denominator has a positive minimum.
remaining_gap: Does not provide any estimate on Bernoulli percolation tauhat_p. Uniform critical infrared control for d=7,8,9,10 remains unproved here.
